title: Beck Depression Inventory-II
description: 21 groups of four statements about the past two weeks, each scored 0–3.

citation.text: Beck AT, Steer RA, Brown GK (1996). Manual for the Beck Depression Inventory-II. San Antonio, TX: Psychological Corporation.

scoring.text: Sum of the 21 items (0–63): 0–13 minimal, 14–19 mild, 20–28 moderate, 29–63 severe. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.

note: Each item has its own four statements: enter them after the item name as `Item 1 | statement 0 | statement 1 | statement 2 | statement 3`. Item 9 (suicidal thoughts) is a safety item: plan how your study responds to a non-zero answer.
